That's why you need a sovereign digital commerce stack, where you own the infrastructure and pay only 0.5% in fees with [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-explained-digital|NOWPayments Integration]]. content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Start digital

A sovereign digital commerce stack is not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure that gives you complete control over your digital business. By using GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, or Google Apps Script for hosting and backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, you can create a decentralized system that doesn't rely on any single platform. NOWPayments, with its 300+ cryptocurrencies and 0.5% fee, is the perfect payment processor for this setup, as it doesn't require KYC or a buyer account, and automatically fires a webhook when the payment confirms on-chain.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you need to have a solid understanding of the underlying technologies and how they work together. You'll need to choose a hosting platform, set up a payment processor, configure order storage and file delivery, and ensure that your stack is scalable and secure. The Complete Builder Kit, available for instant download, provides all the blueprints and templates you need to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack, worth $348 separately.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

One of the key components of a sovereign digital commerce stack is the payment and delivery pipeline. With NOWPayments, you can set up automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, and with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, you can automate the delivery of your digital products to your customers. This means that once a payment is confirmed, your product is automatically delivered to the customer, without any manual intervention required.
Automated delivery means the download link arrives before the buyer navigates away from the payment confirmation page.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Going live with your sovereign digital commerce stack is a crucial step in ensuring that your business is operational and generating revenue. To process your first transaction, you'll need to configure your payment processor, set up your order storage and file delivery systems, and test your pipeline to ensure that it's working correctly. Once you've gone live, you can start processing transactions and generating revenue, with only a 0.5% fee charged by NOWPayments.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your sovereign digital commerce stack is up and running, you can start thinking about scaling your business. With a decentralized system like the one described in this guide, you can easily add more products, customers, and revenue streams, without having to worry about platform failures or fees. The Complete Builder Kit provides all the tools and resources you need to scale your business, including blueprints and templates for deploying and configuring a sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Every digital file type — ebooks, fonts, presets, plugins, templates — works with the same automated delivery pipeline.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
